text:
| Input | Observed result |
|---|---:|
| `category: ""` | 19 skills |
| Second call—also sent as `category: ""` | 19 skills; identical names |
| `category: "__missing_catalog_probe__"` | 0 matches; 19 skills still visible |

The probe means **an unmatched category, not an empty catalog**. The tool explicitly reported that 19 skills remain visible.

**Limitation:** I did not successfully test an omitted category. The exposed tool schema required the field, so the second direct call repeated the empty string; an attempted omitted-field call through the execution wrapper was unavailable. Thus, the two observed listings match exactly, but omitted-category equivalence was not independently verified.

No skills were executed or edited, and no personal state was inspected.
